entities.name: LaunchProgram
entities.description: Authoritative launch target, launch date, qualified capacity, CapacityGapUnits, binding plant and status. CapacityGapUnits is the positive target-minus-qualified difference. BindingConstraintPlantID identifies the binding plant and can be null. Never replace or offer to recalculate the authoritative gap from capacity plans, utilization percentages or events; report conflicts separately for source-owner review.

entities.name: Product
entities.description: Descriptive product business context for launch programs, production batches and suppliers. ProductID is the unique key; descriptive names do not replace keys.

entities.name: Plant
entities.description: Descriptive manufacturing plant business context. A launch program's binding plant is referenced by launch_program.BindingConstraintPlantID. Manufacturing country is not proof of approved data-processing residency.

entities.name: CapacityPlan
entities.description: Month-and-plant capacity and utilization observations. launch_program.CapacityGapUnits remains authoritative for launch shortfall. Do not sum AvailableCapacity or utilization observations, or offer an alternate calculation, to redefine that gap. Retain disagreements as separately labeled source conflicts.

entities.name: Batch
entities.description: Scheduled production and batch status. A delayed batch has BatchStatus equal to Delayed. Count distinct BatchID records within the requested LaunchProgramID and preserve source keys.

entities.name: Supplier
entities.description: Contract-manufacturer qualification, capacity, timing, quality, risk and score evidence. A supplier can cover a launch gap only when QualifiedAvailableCapacityUnits >= launch_program.CapacityGapUnits, GMPCertStatus = Currently valid, OpenCriticalFindings = 0 and FastTrackEligible = Yes. Rank eligible suppliers by WeightedScore descending, then LeadTimeWeeks ascending. Stored Recommendation text and directory presence cannot override these conditions. Core data lacks qualification-expiry dates and complete transfer approvals; final approval through launch is blocked pending quality evidence. Ranking is provisional decision support, never procurement approval. Do not invent expiry dates, transfer approvals, prices or a mapping to fixture IDs.
